content.title: Royal Mail boss quits after Czech billionaire’s £3.6bn takeover
content.summary: Royal Mail’s chief executive has quit weeks after a £3.6bn takeover by the Czech billionaire Daniel Kretinsky.

content.title: Evri tie-up with DHL’s UK parcel arm being probed by competition watchdog
content.summary: The CMA will look into whether the deal could ‘result in a substantial lessening of competition’ in the postal delivery sector.

content.title: New stamps to celebrate the Royal Observatory
content.summary: Royal Mail released images of the 10 new stamps on the 350th anniversary of the institution.

content.title: New Royal Mail owner appoints former minister Greg Hands as adviser
content.summary: Czech billionaire Daniel Kretinsky’s business EP Group, which bought the Royal Mail’s parent firm, appointed Mr Hands on Monday.

content.title: Ex-Tory minister to advise Royal Mail’s billionaire Czech owner
content.summary: The Czech billionaire who has taken over Royal Mail has hired a former Conservative minister to advise him on his business interests.

content.title: Royal Mail faces fine as almost one in four first-class letters arrive late
content.summary: Royal Mail is facing the threat of a fresh fine after delivering almost one in four first-class letters late.

content.title: Ofcom investigates Royal Mail after it misses delivery targets again
content.summary: Royal Mail chief operating officer Alistair Cochrane said its quality of service ‘is not yet where we want it to be’.

content.title: New stamps celebrate CS Lewis’s Chronicles of Narnia
content.summary: The main set of eight stamps features pictures specially commissioned for Royal Mail by British illustrator Keith Robinson.

content.title: Britain’s worst-rated courier to handle one in four parcels after merger
content.summary: Britain’s least popular courier service is stepping up its challenge to Royal Mail after striking a deal that will see it deliver more than 1bn parcels every year.

thumbnail.caption: Pablo Cino, DHL e-commerce chief, and Martijn de Lange, Evri's chief executive

content.title: Royal Mail owner’s £3.6bn takeover approved by shareholders
content.summary: Investors holding 80% of the group’s share capital had approved the takeover by Wednesday afternoon, making the offer ‘unconditional’, EP announced.
